name: Last Vacation
source:
Last Vacation is about a college girl who visits the countryside during her last summer vacation. She meets three brothers who cause her summer vacation to be more interesting than expected.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=12075&p=158123#p158123]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
《Last Vacation》讲述一名女大学生在最后一个暑假前往乡间度假的故事。她在那里遇见三兄弟，而他们让这个暑假变得远比预想中更加精彩。
